name: aspira-kit
description: The Aspira Labs development kit: ui, config, the kit CLI and the agents. One repo, one version, every project.

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:build
scripts.test:build: node packages/ui/scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./packages/agents/*" exec pnpm pack --pack-destination "$PWD/.packs"
